name: SRE · instrumented app HTTP 5xx above 5 percent · 5m
query: min_over_time((((sum by(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (increase(http_server_requests_total{http_response_status_code=~"5..",http_route!~"(?i).*(health|ready|live|metrics).*"}[5m]))) or on(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (0 * (sum by(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (increase(http_server_requests_total{http_route!~"(?i).*(health|ready|live|metrics).*"}[5m])))))/(sum by(cluster_name,namespace,service_name) (increase(http_server_requests_total{http_route!~"(?i).*(health|ready|live|metrics).*"}[5m])) >= 100))[5m:30s])
titleTemplate: SRE · instrumented app HTTP 5xx above 5 percent · 5m · ${cluster_name} · ${namespace} · ${service_name}
description: Uses application counters: 5xx exceeds 5% with at least 100 calls per five-minute window, over observed samples for five minutes. Health attaches to the Kubernetes namespace because the instrumented service name may differ from its Kubernetes Service name.
remediation: Identify the application and route in Instrumented apps. Correlate the spike with application exceptions and dependency traces. Review the service objective and avoid duplicate notification routes when native HTTP/span monitors already cover the same incident.

name: SRE · instrumented app p95 above 3s · 10m
description: Application p95 response time exceeds 3 seconds with at least 100 calls per five-minute calculation window, over observed samples for ten minutes. Health attaches to the namespace; the title identifies the application.
remediation: Check route latency, errors, recent deployments and dependency traces. Three seconds is an initial baseline only; use the application service objective. Compare measurements from the client, proxy and application separately.
